Emma Li: quick heads-up — seeing a ~7pt drop in recall@10 on multilingual devset after pushing per-channel asymmetric INT8 + OPQ for silk-embed-1b. Baseline float32 recall@10 was 0.842, current deployed is 0.772. Mostly for short queries (<6 tokens). :thinking:
Mike Chan: ugh. did we change any postproc? normalization pipeline? PQ expects raw vectors sometimes.
Emma Li: looked into it — index pipeline normalizes at ingest, but the new quantized model was returning normalized vectors too (normalize=True added during export). so we ended up double-normalizing. found in export logs.
Rachel Gomez: double-normalize would squash norms and distort inner-product neighborhoods. if index expects raw + does its own normalize, that explains short-query sensitivity. short queries have lower magnitude — more sensitive to extra norm step.
Sam Patel: reindexing is the obvious path. quick test locally:
```
# quick eval commands
python eval/recall.py --model silk-embed-1b --quant perchannel-int8 --pq --normalize_model True --normalize_index True --k 10
python eval/recall.py --model silk-embed-1b --quant perchannel-int8 --pq --normalize_model False --normalize_index True --k 10
```
Sam Patel: local numbers i ran (same devset):
- float32 baseline recall@10: 0.842
- quant + double-normalize: 0.772
- quant + single-normalize (model raw, index normalizes): 0.833
- quant + single-normalize + efSearch=128: 0.846
Toni Alvarez: nice — so most of the drop was double-normalize, efSearch tweak recovers the rest. did you check clustering metrics? silhouette etc?
Emma Li: yes — silhouette on UMAP embeddings dropped from 0.41 -> 0.29 with the bad pipeline. after fixing normalize flow it returned to 0.39. UMAP plots show cluster compression with double-norm.
Mike Chan: we should also sanity-check L2 vs inner-product settings in the ANN index. PQ + inner-product vs L2 distance interacts with normalization. which metric are we using?
Sam Patel: index is built with inner-product (we normalize at query time historically). PQ operator we used is asymmetric OPQ with inner-product quantization. but some PQ libs expect raw L2. messy.
Rachel Gomez: action items: 1) revert model export to normalize=False for quant builds, 2) trigger full reindex job, 3) rerun eval suite (recall@1/5/10, silhouette, cluster-stability), 4) add a unit test to detect double-normalization drift on CI.
Emma Li: submitted infra job: `job/idx-rebuild-879` (reindex hnsw+pq, efSearch=128). infra-bot should post status. :rocket:
infra-bot: job/idx-rebuild-879 queued by emma.li — estimated time 45m.
Toni Alvarez: I'll run full eval sweep when index is ready. I'll also test efSearch 64/128/256 and M variations. quick note: increasing efSearch improves recall but increases query latency — we need to quantify tradeoff.
Sam Patel: added a tiny eval snippet to detect double-normalize (compare L2 norms of returned vectors vs pre-index raw). will open PR.
Emma Li: thanks all — prioritizing this for today. will post final numbers once reindex finishes. :eyes:
